notes: Factory-owned catalog. Owner intent and architecture outrank these entries. No embeddings, no remote fetch.

patterns.title: Python stdlib web app
patterns.summary: Local HTML/CSS/JS served by python3 -m src.app on port 8765 with JSON files under data/. First executable Crazy Factory stack.

patterns.title: Habit tracker product class
patterns.summary: Define habits, record dated completions, persist across restart, show streak and weekly view. Claims are verified by runtime, persistence, and visible evidence — not identifier names.

patterns.title: JSON file persistence
patterns.summary: Store application records as JSON under data/. Restart must observe the same records. File presence is not sufficient evidence.

patterns.title: Dated completion
patterns.summary: A completion is stored or returned with an associated calendar date. Do not require a specific field name.

patterns.title: Habit streak
patterns.summary: A known completion history produces an observable or computable streak. Do not require current_streak or streak_count identifiers.

patterns.title: Weekly view
patterns.summary: The running app shows or returns a week-scoped view of completions. Prefer visible or API evidence over CSS class names.

patterns.title: Form and list
patterns.summary: A reachable HTML UI that can create a record through a form and then show it in a list or table.

patterns.title: Preview-first loop
patterns.summary: Stand up a localhost HTTP UI early so runtime observation can probe a real page, then keep iterating on that preview.

patterns.title: Default web stack record
patterns.summary: stdlib-web is executable; vite-react is recorded and not executable until npm is allowlisted.

patterns.title: Task-board web seed
patterns.summary: First stdlib-web benchmark seed used to prove prompt to runnable preview.
